description: Localization file for the Select2 plugin providing Japanese translations for various UI messages.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message indicating input is too long, suggesting deletion of excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message indicating input is too short, prompting user to enter more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message displayed while loading more results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.
